scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Huh? Do I know you? It's creepy that you seem so familiar. You don't have a twin, do you?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
咦？我认识你吗？
你看起来好眼熟，真是让人毛骨悚然。
你该不会有个双胞胎吧？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What, do you want to be a Thief? I'm sorry, but you look like you need more training.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
什么，你想成为盗贼？
抱歉，你看起来还需要更多训练。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Take your time and learn all the Basic Skills, will you? Well then, see you later~!
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
慢慢来，把基本技能都学会，好吗？
那么，下次再见啦~！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Well, I got this feeling like you've been through a lifetime of fighting, so I'm promoting you to a Thief right this minute. I better give you tough guys what you want...
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
总觉得你像是打了一辈子的仗。
好，现在就让你转职成盗贼。
你们这些狠角色想要什么，我还是照办的好...

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Since you've become a Thief, live as a Thief. Now, go for it! Next~
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
既然你成为了盗贼，就要像盗贼一样生活。
去吧！下一个~

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hey, dude.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
嘿，伙计。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hey, baby~
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
嘿，宝贝~

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hey, dude.
...Hey! You look too goody-goody to want to be a Thief!! Now scram, I'm busy. Next!
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
嘿，伙计。
...嘿！你看起来太正经了，不像想当盗贼的样子！！
快走吧，我很忙。下一个！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hey, baby.
...Hey! You look too goody-goody to want to be a Thief!! Now scram, I'm busy. Next!
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
嘿，宝贝。
...嘿！你看起来太正经了，不像想当盗贼的样子！！
快走吧，我很忙。下一个！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
If you have a problem, feel free to speak to me anytime, alright?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
如果你有问题，随时可以来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
Huh.
Now, that's
a big sword.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
搞什么...？
嚯，这剑可真大。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
What's a Mage doin' here? Shouldn't you be doing card tricks elsewhere? Oh well, it's a free country...
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
搞什么...？
魔法师来这儿干嘛？
你不是该去别处玩纸牌魔术吗？
算了，反正这儿来去自由...

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
You're a Merchant,
right? Why are you
walking into a den
of Thieves?!
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
搞什么...？
你是商人吧？
怎么跑到盗贼窝里来了？！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
Oh my God...
Am I dying?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
搞什么...？
我的天...
难道我要死了？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
Didn't you use to be one of us?! Man, you changed. You seem real dangerous now...
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
搞什么...？
你以前不是我们的人吗？！
伙计，你变了，现在看起来真危险...

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
Man, you got real cool all of a sudden! You must have some skills I can only dream of!
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
搞什么...？
伙计，你怎么突然这么酷了！
你的本领，我怕是做梦都学不来！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
搞什么...？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
Man, shouldn't you
Archers be playing
in the forest
or something?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
搞什么...？
伙计，你们弓箭手不是该在森林里玩儿吗？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
You know we all steal for a living, right? What are you doing in this kinda place, Acolyte?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
搞什么...？
你知道我们都是靠偷东西过活的吧？
服事，你来这种地方干什么？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
So...
Trying to make
up for something
...Buddy?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
所以...
你这是想弥补什么不足吗...伙计？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Oh wait,
it's not...
Get outta here!
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
哦，等等，不是...
滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
It's like you're begging
us to steal from you!
Come on, hurry and
get outta here~
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
你这简直是在求我们偷你的东西！
行了，赶紧出去~

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Why else would a Priest come here? I guess I better start confessing all of my misdeeds.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
牧师来这里，还能为了什么？
看来我得赶紧把自己的坏事都招了。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
*Sigh* Look, there's really no need for you to be in this kind of place. You oughta go where you ought to go.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
*叹气*听着，你真没必要待在这种地方。
该去哪儿就去哪儿吧。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hmmm?
You gathered Mushrooms for
the Thief test, right?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
嗯？
你去采盗贼考试要用的蘑菇了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Here, talk to the other guy right next to me. He's the one in charge of checking your Mushrooms.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
找我旁边那个人吧，他负责检查你带来的蘑菇。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
So how was the
Mushroom Farm?
Have any fun?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
蘑菇农场怎么样？
玩得开心吗？

scripts.text: Yeah, kinda Cool.
scripts.translation: 是啊，还挺有意思

scripts.text: It was horrible.
scripts.translation: 糟透了

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Heh heh! That's a good attitude. In our line of work, you gotta enjoy getting your hands dirty, one way or another.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
嘿嘿！
这态度不错。
干我们这行，总得乐意干些不干净的活儿。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Yeah? I've been there too, so I can see why that place isn't everyone's cup of tea. Still, being a Thief isn't all glamour and trendy night life.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
是吗？
我也去过，知道那地方不是谁都喜欢的。
不过，当盗贼可不光是风光体面、夜夜潇洒。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hey, whaddya doin' here? Aren't you supposed to be gathering Mushrooms? Or did you need it explained to you again?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
嘿，你在这儿干嘛？不是应该去采蘑菇吗？还是说你需要我再解释一遍？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No, that's okay.
scripts.translation: 不用了

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
*Sigh* Well, there's always one in the bunch. Alright, listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
*叹气*总有那么几个记不住的。
好，仔细听。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Alright, for your test, you gotta steal Mushrooms from a farm. Don't worry, the guy who owns the farm deserves to be robbed.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
考试要你去农场偷蘑菇。
别担心，那个农场主被偷也是活该。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Anyway, you gotta gather two kinds of Mushrooms: ^0000FFOrange Net Mushrooms^000000 and ^0000FFOrange Gooey Mushrooms^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
总之，你得采集两种蘑菇：^0000FF毒香菇^000000和^0000FF恶臭香菇^000000。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Be careful, since there are monsters are the farm that are there to protect the Mushrooms. So this will be no walk in the park.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
小心，农场里有魔物守着蘑菇。
这趟可不轻松。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
When you come back here after gathering Mushrooms, you'll be graded on the Mushrooms you've collected.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
采完蘑菇回来，我们会根据你带来的蘑菇评分。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Each Orange Net Mushroom gets you 3 points, and you get 1 point for each Orange Gooey Mushroom. You need a total of 25 points to pass the test.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
每颗毒香菇算3分，每颗恶臭香菇算1分。
总分达到25分，就能通过考试。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Go outside and keep going ahead toward the Eastern Field of the Pyramids. Then you will see one of our comrades between two columns.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
出去后，继续往金字塔东边的野外走。
你会在两根柱子之间看到我们的一个同伙。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Speak to that guy, and he'll take you to the farm through the backdoor.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
找他谈谈，他会带你从后门进入农场。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
On that field, I think his coordinates are '^FF0000141, 125^000000.' Just type ^3355FF/where^000000 in the right side of your chat box to check your present coordinates.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
他在那片野外的坐标，我记得是“^FF0000141, 125^000000”。
在聊天框右侧输入^3355FF/where^000000，就能查看自己当前的坐标。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Huh. For a second there, I thought you had something really important to tell me.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
哼，刚才我还以为你有什么要紧事呢。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What brings you down
here to this rathole?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
什么风把你吹到这个老鼠洞来了？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Ah...
You came back.
Are you sure you're
ready to try again?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
啊，你回来了。
确定准备好再试一次了？

scripts.text: Hey, I came here to be a Thief!
scripts.translation: 嘿，我来这里是为了成为盗贼！

scripts.text: Nah, I'm just looking around.
scripts.translation: 没，我只是随便看看

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Heh, I like your confidence. Still, you know being a Thief isn't all what it's cracked up to be.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
嘿，我喜欢你这份自信。
不过，当盗贼可没别人吹得那么好。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Still...
Do you really
want to be
a Thief?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
不过...
你真的想当盗贼？

scripts.text: Yeah.
scripts.translation: 是啊

scripts.text: No, just wasting your time.
scripts.translation: 不，就是来浪费你时间的

scripts.text: Why did you become a Thief?
scripts.translation: 你为什么成为盗贼？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Really...
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
真是的...

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Yeah...
I can see that.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
是啊...
我看出来了。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Me...?
I had no choice at the time. It was either steal or starve. But it's not like I need to give you my life story.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
我...？
那时候没得选，不偷就得饿死。
不过，我也没必要跟你交代这辈子的事。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
So do you want to
apply to become
a Thief or not?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
所以，你到底要不要申请当盗贼？

scripts.text: Yes, I will.
scripts.translation: 是，我愿意

scripts.text: I'm too scared to be a Thief!
scripts.translation: 当盗贼太吓人了！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Alright, tell
me your name.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
好吧，告诉我你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
{0}?
What kind of name is {1}? Anyway, give me a second.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
{0}？
{1}是什么怪名字？
算了，等我一下。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Alright, your registration has been processed. Okay, you can begin your test if you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
好，已经登记好了。
准备好了，就可以开始考试。

scripts.text: Yeah, I'm ready.
scripts.translation: 准备好了

scripts.text: No, I'm not ready yet.
scripts.translation: 还没准备好

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Not ready?
How can you
not be ready?!
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
没准备好？
怎么还没准备好？！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Too scared?!?
Hahahahahahah!
Oh, please...!
That's hilarious!
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
太害怕了？！
Hahahahahahah!
拜托...！
真是笑死我了！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Okay...
Give me
one second.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
好...
等我一下。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Your name is...
{0}? Um, where is it? Ah, here it is. Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
你叫...{0}？
嗯，记在哪儿了？
啊，找到了。
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Isn't that cute? I can see you're ambitious, but you gotta learn all of the Basic Skills before you can become a Thief.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
哟，还挺可爱。
看得出你有志气，不过想当盗贼，得先学会所有基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Alright. I looked at your Felony Record, and you seem to have a very interesting history. You might have what it takes to be a Thief.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
好，我看过你的重罪记录了，经历还真有意思。
说不定，你真有当盗贼的潜质。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Because I feel like it, I now decree that you have passed this interview. Good work!
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
我心情不错，就宣布你通过面试吧。
干得好！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Now, your actual abilities will need to be tested. Do you know anything about the test?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
接下来，该考考你的实际本领了。
知道考试内容吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 知道

scripts.text: Sorry, I don't.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，不知道

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Oh yeah? Well, this makes things a lot easier.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
哦，是吗？
那就省事多了。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Alright, let me inform you then. Listen carefully. This test decides if you are worthy of becoming a Thief.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
好，那我来说明。
仔细听，这场考试决定你有没有资格当盗贼。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
You will be sneaking to Shibu's Farm. He is the worst Merchant, in terms of character, in Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
你要潜入西布的农场。
那家伙是梦罗克商人里人品最差的。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Alright, for your test, you gotta steal Mushrooms from his farm. Don't worry, that guy deserves to be robbed.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
考试要你去他的农场偷蘑菇。
别担心，那家伙被偷也是活该。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Anyway, you gotta gather two kinds of Mushrooms: ^0000FFOrange Net Mushrooms^000000 and ^0000FFOrange Gooey Mushrooms^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
总之，你得采集两种蘑菇：^0000FF毒香菇^000000和^0000FF恶臭香菇^000000。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Be careful, since there are monsters are the farm that are there to protect the Mushrooms. So this will be no walk in the park.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
小心，农场里有魔物守着蘑菇。
这趟可不轻松。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
When you come back here after gathering Mushrooms, you'll be graded on the Mushrooms you've collected.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
采完蘑菇回来，我们会根据你带来的蘑菇评分。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Each Orange Net Mushroom gets you 3 points, and you get 1 point for each Orange Gooey Mushroom. You need a total of 25 points to pass the test.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
每颗毒香菇算3分，每颗恶臭香菇算1分。
总分达到25分，就能通过考试。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Go outside and keep going ahead toward the Eastern Field of the Pyramids. Then you will see one of our comrades between two columns.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
出去后，继续往金字塔东边的野外走。
你会在两根柱子之间看到我们的一个同伙。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Speak to that guy, and he'll take you to the farm through the backdoor.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
找他谈谈，他会带你从后门进入农场。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
On that field, I think his coordinates are '^FF0000141, 125^000000.' Just type ^3355FF/where^000000 in the right side of your chat box to check your present coordinates.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
他在那片野外的坐标，我记得是“^FF0000141, 125^000000”。
在聊天框右侧输入^3355FF/where^000000，就能查看自己当前的坐标。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Don't forget to make plans and prepare yourself before you go inside the Mushroom Farm. Move as quickly as you can and try not to get killed, alright?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
进蘑菇农场前，别忘了做好计划，备齐东西。
动作尽量快些，可别把命丢了，明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Brad]
We don't have any special events yet. Come some other time when there's news, alright?
scripts.translation:
[布拉德]
我们目前还没有任何特别活动。等有新消息的时候再来吧，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Um...
You don't look
like a Thief.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
嗯...
你看起来不像盗贼。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
What the heck are
you doing here anyway?
scripts.translation:
[同志]
你到底来这里干什么？

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
What's the matter? If you want to be a Thief, speak to the girl beside me.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
怎么了？
想当盗贼，就找我旁边的女孩谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Did you pass the interview?
Then what are you waiting for?
scripts.translation:
[同志]
你通过面试了吗？
那你在等什么？

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Ah, the guide told me about you. So, let me check your mushrooms...
scripts.translation:
[同志]
啊，向导跟我说过你的事。
让我看看你带来的蘑菇...

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
What the hell...
You don't have any Mushrooms at all! Go back and get them. Otherwise, you won't pass the test and become a Thief!
scripts.translation:
[同志]
搞什么鬼...
你一颗蘑菇都没带！
回去采来，不然可过不了考试，更当不了盗贼！

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
First, let me check the Orange Net Mushrooms you got.
Huh, {0} of them.
Now I'll just check your Orange Gooey Mushrooms. That's {1} you gathered.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
先看看你采的毒香菇。
嗯，有{0}颗。
再看看恶臭香菇，有{1}颗。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Now I'll just check your Orange Gooey Mushrooms. That's {0} you gathered.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
再看看恶臭香菇，有{0}颗。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
First, let me check the Orange Net Mushrooms you got.
Huh, {0} of them.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
先看看你采的毒香菇。
嗯，有{0}颗。

scripts.text: [Comrade]
scripts.translation: [同志]

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
So that would
bring your total to...
scripts.translation:
[同志]
那么，你的总分应该是...

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Hmmm. {0} degrees, multiplied by the speed of light, divided by the integral of pi times height plus the absolute value of politics...
scripts.translation:
[同志]
嗯，{0}度，乘以光速，再除以π乘高度的积分，加上政治的绝对值...

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Okay!
I got it.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
好了！
我算出来了。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Definitely less than the 25 points you need to pass. Go out there and get me more Mushrooms!
scripts.translation:
[同志]
肯定低于通过所需的25分。去外面给我多采点蘑菇！

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
You got more
than 25 points!
Awesome!
scripts.translation:
[同志]
你超过了25分！
太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Exactly 25 points!
You did it! Badass!
scripts.translation:
[同志]
正好25分！
你做到了！真厉害！

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
{0}...
You have passed the official Thief Test. You are now one of us.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
{0}...
你通过了正式的盗贼测试。现在，你也是我们的一员了。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Congratulations on becoming a Thief! From now, be an honorable representative of the Thief's Guild.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
恭喜你成为盗贼！从现在开始，请作为盗贼公会的荣誉代表行事。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
If you bring disgrace to our guild, you will be killed. I expect you to bring our comrades pride.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
如果你给公会带来耻辱，你会被处死。我期待你能为我们的同志带来荣耀。

scripts.text:
[Brad]
*Ahem* Welcome to the Guild, comrade! I'm Brad, and I'm in charge of human resources here.
scripts.translation:
[布拉德]
*咳* 欢迎加入公会，同志！我是布拉德，这里负责人力资源。

scripts.text:
[Brad]
Here is a small subsidy for a Newbie like you. Spend it whereever you want. Alright then, I'll see you around~
scripts.translation:
[布拉德]
这是给像你这样的新人的小额补贴。你想怎么花就怎么花。那么，回头见~

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Ah, I see that you are now a Thief. I always knew you'd join us.
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
啊，看来你现在已经是盗贼了。我一直知道你会加入我们。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Stealing from a Mushroom farm is too easy for you now. You should build up your skills and master our craft.
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
从蘑菇农场偷东西对你来说太简单了。你应该磨练技艺，精通我们的手艺。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
I could use a good, hard drink.
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
我想来杯好酒，好好喝一顿。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Gimme your money.
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
把你的钱交出来。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
WHO YOU CALLING A PSYCHO?!?!
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
谁是你说的疯子？！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
I've got nothing to say to you. Would you mind leaving me alone?
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
我没什么话想跟你说。你能不能别缠着我？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Today looks like a good day to go to the pyramids and hunt with some of my friends.
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
今天看起来是个好日子，适合去金字塔和朋友们一起打怪。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Kidding, I'm off the clock.
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
开玩笑的，我现在下班了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Hahahahaha~!
You haven't
passed the test yet?
Alright, I'll let you in...
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
哈哈哈哈哈~！
你还没通过测试吗？
好吧，我让你进去...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Hmm...
You've come to take the test, right? I can see in your eyes that you know something.
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
嗯...
你是来接受测试的吧？我从你的眼神里看出你知道些什么。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Your name is {0}? Ah, it's on the list. Alright, I'll let you into the Mushroom Farm , but I can't guarantee your safety...
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
你的名字是{0}？啊，在名单上。好吧，我让你进入蘑菇农场，但我不能保证你的安全...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
There is this strange smell coming from... You. Now why would that be?
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
有一股奇怪的味道从...你身上散发出来。这到底是为什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Hey Novice! Why don't you join the ranks of the Thief Guild? You newbies are always welcome to join us and our selfish cause.
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
嘿，初心者！为什么不加入盗贼公会的行列呢？我们随时欢迎新人加入，为了我们自私的目标。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
You can get more information in the Underground Room in the Pyramid 1 BF.
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
你可以在金字塔1层地下室的房间里获取更多信息。
